why_not_in_the_manifest: The manifest is write-once by design — rewriting it would silently re-label every row already filed under this run. A caveat found after the run is exactly what must not be smuggled into it, so it rides beside the run as its own file.
observed_reasons: rejected by the multiple floor or a distress signal
what_it_records: ROUTING, not the gate. The FAIL reason reads 'rejected by the multiple floor or a distress signal' — one key for two decisions, so a FAIL row does not say which one rejected the name.
these_rows_CAN_be_used_for: the admitted/rejected split at the END of the screen (the routing outcome itself)
counting how many candidates reached the G3 stage at all
G1 and G2 gate analysis — those keys are unaffected by this conflation
these_rows_CANNOT_be_used_for: any G3 multiple-floor hit rate or threshold calibration
distinguishing a multiple-floor rejection from a distress rejection
any per-gate FAIL attribution at the G3 stage
comparison against a later run's g3_multiple_floor counts — different populations

superseded_by.note: Runs carrying these recorded the two decisions separately; use those for gate-level questions.
